description: A wall post written on another actor's profile wall. On ActivityPub this is a Note whose enclosing Create activity carries an AS2 `target` property pointing to the wall owner's actor URI (Friendica-compatible). On ATProto the record is stored in the author's repo under the `org.activitypods.wall.post` collection.

main.description: Write on another actor's profile wall.

text.description: The text content of the wall post. Plain text; rich-text facets may be supplied in the `facets` field.

wallTarget.description: The actor whose profile wall this post is being written on.

langs.description: BCP-47 language tags for the post text. Should have at most one entry for wall posts.

facets.description: Annotations (mentions, links, hashtags) on ranges of the `text` field, following the `app.bsky.richtext.facet` schema.

bridgeSource.description: Provenance metadata when this record was bridged from ActivityPub. Omitted for natively ATProto-authored wall posts.

createdAt.description: Client-declared creation timestamp. Servers should clamp future-dated values to the current time.
